sections.heading: Proposal Summary
sections.text: This proposal, SYN-SYNCP000117-P1, was presented by the Supplier to Atlantic Health Network 117 on April 1, 2026.

sections.heading: Supplier Concession
sections.text: Supplier concession: an administrative fee of 1.25%.

sections.heading: Supplier Request
sections.text: Supplier request: a commitment of 1,630 Influenza doses per year.

sections.heading: Proposal Status
sections.text: Status of this proposal: awaiting a Customer decision.
